feature: DMG Synth hamburger Menu / Files instrument loading

scope.menu: Reuse the shared FM2612/SPU hamburger helper for Import / Export / Reset. Original buttons and inputs keep stable IDs; outside click, Escape and action selection close the menu.
scope.vgm: Dedicated Menu import saves exact VGM/VGZ bytes under /vgm and validated static presets under a unique /presets/<song>/ folder. No editor apply or autoplay.
scope.instruments: Importing a DMG JSON adds it to Files; selecting its JSON is the explicit sound-apply action. Keyboard/Code mode stays unchanged.
scope.storage: Bulk sound writes validate all voices and preflight shared 16 MiB capacity before one commit. Portable NFC/case-fold collision-safe names never overwrite existing sounds.
scope.cancellation: File reading, analysis, raw storage and sound storage are fenced; superseded JSON reads/flushes cannot commit or publish a late status.

coverage: Exact original VGZ bytes and independently reported raw/sound storage failures, including zero voices.
Real extraction of six fixture voices, full-batch validation/capacity atomicity, portable names/collisions, ZIP round-trip.
Current sound, raw selection/revision, active Code path/mode/focus and pending editor draft stay intact during sound saving.
External isCurrent fences pending file reads, flush and workspace retirement; committed sound batches remain committed after late cancellation.
Existing actual-WASM instrument, Pause audition and seek timing checks remain passing.

tauri.coverage: Reuse the frontend menu without duplicate IDs or event bindings; preserve older frontend fallback. Existing desktop checker supports both workflows and accepts --dist without changing pinned assets.

visualReview: Chromium 1240px and WebKit 390px: one compact header menu, main Sounds from VGM panel removed, instrument loading through Files.
The SPU-style menu scrolls vertically within the viewport and preserves keyboard performance after dismissal.
limits: The existing VGM extraction subset and 64 MiB input/decompressed limit remain; Files shares a 16 MiB project limit.
Raw-source saving and sound-batch saving are independent transactions; a reported partial storage failure does not discard the successful part.
Tauri adapter/tests were updated; native dist import, signing/build and publishing remain separate release steps.
